title: Bilevel Optimization with Lower-Level Uniform Convexity: Theory and Algorithm
summary: Bilevel optimization is a hierarchical framework where an upper-level optimization problem is constrained by a lower-level problem, commonly used in machine learning applications such as hyperparameter optimization. Existing bilevel optimization methods typically assume strong convexity or Polyak-Łojasiewicz (PL) conditions for the lower-level function to establish non-asymptotic convergence to a solution with small hypergradient.
